title: WebhookCreateRequest.Data.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe the webhook you’re creating.

Apple Business API 2.8+

enabled.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the webhook is enabled.

eventTypes.description: The event types that the webhook subscribes to. See [WebhookEventType](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/webhookeventtype) for possible values.

secret.description: The secret for the webhook. The API doesn’t return this value in responses.

url.description: The URL that receives webhook event notifications.
